BiblicalUsage: Bozez is one of the two sharp rocks at the pass of Michmash, named in the account of Jonathan's climb to the Philistine garrison. The name marks the steep ground Jonathan had to cross, a crag on one side of the passage.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God remembers the very rocks His people climbed, and Bozez is proof that no part of the story is too small to be named.
